observations: All three epochs still contain major category and layout mismatches on the fixed32 examples.
Examples of later improvement include pizza/table context at2706 and candidate1 cat with keyboard at1359; earlier109 also performs better in individual cases such as the toddler at5267.
Aircraft and some human/animal subjects show increased detail later, but extra detail does not ensure correct stimulus reconstruction.
Fixed32 visual examples do not establish a global win rate; the full500 numerical comparison determines the registered gate.
scientific_correction: The fixed32 noise-loss plateau did not imply a plateau of reconstruction metrics:372 is better on7 of8 aggregate metrics. No claim that109 is globally best or that continuing training had no benefit.
